payload.comment:
Reporting stage is internally consistent and all cross-artefact references verify correctly.

Verification summary:

(1) OOD aggregate: ood_auroc = 0.776469 = (0.91225 + 0.859081 + 0.558075)/3 ✓. ood_validation_auroc = 0.846789 = (0.983162 + 0.967768 + 0.589439)/3 ✓. Arithmetic mean of selected-score AUROCs across severities, as specified.

(2) Accuracy consistency: base_test_accuracy (0.905571) in abstention_report matches agentic_accuracy in comparison_report and evaluation_report. Confusion-matrix diagonal (6502/7180) = 0.905571 ✓.

(3) Comparison arithmetic: accuracy_delta = 0.905571 − 0.840251 = 0.06532 ✓. baseline_met_or_exceeded = true is supported ✓.

(4) Split/seed integrity: All artefacts (baseline, ablation, abstention, comparison) share seed 47 and split_fingerprint 9afc9ed3…7505. Like-for-like comparison confirmed.

(5) Ablation design: Three scenarios (representation_off, standardize_only, standardize_hflip) form a coherent factorial decomposition of normalization × augmentation. All use the same split and seed.

(6) Deterministic findings: Empty. No pipeline defects detected.

Carried-forward advisories (all non-blocking, unchanged from prior stages):
- Test coverage (0.6599) is ~14 pp below target validation coverage (0.8001); effective abstain rate on new data will exceed the validation-calibrated 0.34.
- OOD AUROC at σ=0.4 drops to 0.558 (max_softmax) / 0.492 (predictive_entropy), near or below chance; corruption proxy has limited discriminative power at high severity.
- Per-class weaknesses (cancer-associated stroma recall 0.546; smooth muscle F1 0.735) may cause disproportionate abstention; stratified analysis recommended downstream.
- Ablation covers hflip only; best configuration also uses rotate180. A combined scenario would complete augmentation ablation.
- No confidence interval on the accuracy delta; individual-metric CIs exist but are not propagated to the delta.
- Prior-art quotes (ghostnet_vgg_robustness, temp_scaling_calibration) extend beyond truncated source text; verify against full papers before further design encoding.
- llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8; exact LLM weights not pinned (auxiliary).
- ~9 pp gap between best validation accuracy (0.995) and test accuracy (0.906) warrants interpretation but is not a pipeline defect.

Minor metadata note: reporting_status.complete_through_stage reads "ablation" while the current stage is "reporting" with abstention and comparison stages completed in between. This appears to be a status-tracking lag rather than a content defect; no action required.

All 45 artefact versions are accounted for, 96 decision events logged, and the dossier path is present. The reporting stage is complete and consistent.
